spans.s:
n. (-कं)
A horse's trot: see धोरितक.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Fit for burthen, capable of taking or bearing it, (either a vehicle or a beast, &c.)
m. (-यः)
1 A beast of burthen.
2 A horse.
E.
धूर् a burthen, ढक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging to a cheat, knavish, fraudulent, &c.
n. (-कं)
Fraud, dishonesty.
E.
धूर्त्त a cheat, ठन् aff.

n. (-र्य्यं)
A horse's trot.
E.
धोर to go well, affix यञ्.
